svg.aria-label: A Hyprland desktop with a waybar along the bottom. A build turns the Roundhouse lamp red; its drawer explains that memory is stalling and Switchyard is holding the next build, and its link opens the Switchyard board, where storefront finishes, the lamp calms and android starts. Then the view zooms along the bar from left to right: the song pauses, the volume switches to the headset, the mouse battery runs low, dictation types a comment into the editor, the meeting recorder lights up, the clock starts a focus block, the key lights warm the room, the VPN connects, a swaync notification arrives and do not disturb silences it and hides the song title, and the clock names the next meeting, then turns red to join it.

g.text: // back off and retry, give up after five tries
everything is stalling on memory (22% of the last 10 s)
Switchyard is holding android: Roundhouse says everything is…
one lamp for the whole machine, red when it needs you
click it to see why: memory is stalling
its link opens the build board from the same lamp
storefront finishes, the lamp calms, the held build starts
middle-click pauses, click opens the player
click to switch to the headset
hold a key and talk; the lamp listens with you
voxtype types it where the cursor is
a meeting on air; its transcript makes itself after
a focus block that ends before the next meeting
both Elgato lights in one click
one click for the work VPN
swaync, in the same Nord colors
silences them, and hides the song title for screen shares
the clock says what's next, amber 10 minutes out
red at start time; middle-click joins on workspace 2
